heading: Sovereign Judgment and the Three Stages of Exile
ascii:
THE THREE SIEGES OF JERUSALEM
605 B.C. (1st Campaign)  -->  Jehoiakim vassalized; Daniel & royal youths deported
597 B.C. (2nd Campaign)  -->  Jehoiachin deposed; Ezekiel & 10,000 deported (BM 21946)
586 B.C. (3rd Campaign)  -->  Zedekiah blinded; Temple burned; Jerusalem destroyed

heading: The Battle for Identity
ascii:
THE CONFLICT OF NAMES
HEBREW NAME (CONFESSING YAHWEH)          BABYLONIAN NAME (HONORING IDOLS)
Daniel      ("God is my Judge")     -->  Belteshazzar ("Bel protect his life")
Hananiah    ("Yahweh is Gracious")  -->  Shadrach     (trad.: "Command of Aku" -- debated)
Mishael     ("Who is like God?")    -->  Meshach      (trad.: "Who is what Aku is?" -- debated)
Azariah     ("Yahweh has Helped")   -->  Abednego     ("Servant of Nebo")

heading: The Crisis at the Royal Table
ascii:
THE DIETARY CRISIS
Royal Table (The World's Offer)           Zeroim & Water (The Covenant Stand)
- Typically dedicated to Marduk/Bel       - Dedicated entirely to Yahweh
- May have violated Levitical food laws   - Undefiled nourishment (Dan 1:12)

heading: The Redemptive Apex
ascii:
THE REDEMPTIVE TYPOLOGY
DANIEL IN BABYLON                         JESUS IN THE WILDERNESS
- Captive in exile                        - The Son incarnate in an alienated world
- Tempted with royal meat and wine        - Tempted by Satan with bread and kingdoms
- Refused to defile covenant purity       - Refused every illicit compromise
- Sustained by God's provision            - "Man shall not live by bread alone"
- Granted wisdom to interpret kingdoms    - The King whose kingdom fills the earth
